Assessment.content: Clinical impression is dermatitis or contact dermatitis.
Assessment.source_text: I think um, based on your story, I I think you might have something called dermatitis or contact dermatitis.

Assessment.content: Exposure to cleaning products without gloves likely contributes to skin symptoms.
Assessment.source_text: Which is very common in, particularly people in your in your in your field, who are using cleaning products, not using gloves. And sometimes you get a bit of reaction between the chemicals and your skin.

Plan_of_Care.source_text: what we try and do is, you know, avoid the triggers.

Plan_of_Care.content: Strongly recommend wearing gloves at all times when cleaning.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I strongly recommend that you wear gloves when cleaning at all times.

Plan_of_Care.content: Start topical steroid creams to reduce inflammation.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we can try some steroid creams to help with the inflammation.

Plan_of_Care.content: Use stronger emollients three to four times daily for the next couple of weeks.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: As well as some stronger emollients, um which you really need to kind of coat on, three four times a day, for the next couple of weeks, just to help with the moisturizing of your skin.
